hooks.name: Inbox Triage Hint
hooks.description: When a loose note is created in 00-Inbox, suggest a destination token in one line. Fires only for that folder, never on unrelated messages.

action.prompt: A note was just created in 00-Inbox. In ONE short line, suggest where it belongs using the triage token vocabulary: #do (actionable today), #dev, #concept, #learn, #ref, #personal, #project, or #bin. Name the token and the destination folder only. Do not create a triage note, do not list the tag taxonomy, and do not explain the system. If the note clearly already belongs somewhere, say which folder to move it to instead.
